notes.title: 🩸 Game Update🩸
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone... 

The latest update is here to exorcise a few demons:

🧟‍♂️ Fixed a critical bug that appeared when starting a new story game for the second time.

🕷️ Squashed several minor bugs and creepy translation issues.

Thanks for surviving with us... and good luck out there. 🔦👁️[/h3]

notes.title: Exorcist Simulator Has Launched!
notes.content:
[h2]Evil has arrived — and it’s your job to send it back.🕯️[/h2]

[h3]Enter the terrifying world of Exorcist Simulator, a brand-new first-person multiplayer horror game. Hunt demons, master powerful spells, and survive brutal encounters in haunted monasteries and abandoned dungeons.

[b]Key Features:[/b]
[u]🔹Thrilling First-Person Combat [/u]— Every shot, every spell could be your last.
[u]🔹Haunting Locations [/u]— Explore sinister dungeons, dark woods, and forgotten temples.
[u]🔹 Multiplayer Mayhem[/u] — Team up with friends or face off against rival exorcists.
[u]🔹Solve Mysteries [/u]— Discover relics, secrets, and puzzles hidden in the shadows.
[u]🔹Real Atmosphere [/u]— Feel the tension with stunning visuals and bone-chilling sounds.

Play solo or with friends — only the brave will endure.

🎁 We’re giving away FREE game keys!
Be among the first to dive in —  grab yours while they last!

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We have made a small update to the demo version of our game. It includes the following changes:
[list]
[*]The beginning of the game now takes place immediately at the location.
[*]The devil, upon death, is blown to pieces and then spectacularly reassembled.
[*]Added a chat feature.
[*]Fixed bugs.
[/list]
